goal: Maximize useful SEO/AEO/GEO surfaces with an aggressive Approval Prep publishing priority, practical editorial judgment, and tolerant operating margins.
default_launch_date: auto-created on first run if data/autopilot-state.json is missing

daily_rules.condition: last_7_day_pass_rate >= 0.85 and duplicate warnings are diagnostic only, else 3
hold at 6 unless pass rate drops below 0.75, then 3
9 only if last_14_day_pass_rate >= 0.85, avg_quality >= 85, duplicate warnings are diagnostic only
9 if quality remains healthy; 6 if mixed; 3 if failures rise

priority_targets.quality_policy: Aim for 5-8 pages daily and preserve aggressive momentum. Daily variation, word counts, page counts, anchor length, and product mix are warning-only; only structural corruption, false evidence, wrong-domain routing, or clearly prohibited claims may block publication.
